title: 第三章 古怪寺庙第四章 隐藏之门
lines: 刘听寒等众人一看李磊这般模样，便纷纷下马把李磊护了起来。
“你怎么这么傻啊!”紧接着刘听寒更是把李磊抱在了怀里。
而向他们追来的孙志才等一众黑衣人却在他们面前停了下来并没有出手。
“真是兄弟情深啊李磊，看看你这个模样真是自找的”孙志才一脸得意的说道。
面对孙志才这样的话语刘听寒等人怒火中烧。
刘听寒看了看李磊，又看了看身后的兄弟们强忍怒气，以十分卑微的语气问道“你能不能放过李磊，只要放了他让我们做什么都可以，哪怕让我们去死”
“哈哈哈!真是可笑，要你们这些蝼蚁有什么用，现在我反悔了不仅你们得死，就连李磊也休想活着!”
只见孙志才刚说完话，他身后的黑衣人大军却是蓄势待发，好像只要孙志才一声令下那群黑衣人就一拥而上把李磊他们撕的粉碎。
听到这样的话语刘听寒并没有跟孙志才有过多的商量，因为他知道以孙志才的性格就算是答应了李磊也肯定活不了。
于是刘听寒环顾一周，和兄弟们互看了一眼便站起身来把李磊交给了刘听寒身边的一个兄弟。随后又转过身面对着孙志才，拳头握的嘎吱作响。
“几个人带李磊走，不怕死的都给我上，杀!”
只见刘听寒等人竟毅然决然的冲向了那乌压压的黑衣人大军，只留下那零星几人和李磊在那。
而手里抱着李磊的那个兄弟也没有过多的犹豫抱着李磊和另外几人上马向远处飞奔而去。
李磊看着远去的刘听寒等人和那群黑衣人拼杀的情景李磊已经接近崩溃，李磊并非是贪生怕死之辈，只是看着自己像亲兄弟一样的刘听寒陷入苦战，面对这样的情形而他却无能为力只能亲眼看着他去送死，此时此刻李磊的心里更是波涛汹涌，五味杂陈，眼里不争气的泪水更是止不住的狂流。
也不知道是悲伤过度还是失血太多李磊竟然昏了过去。
“醒醒啊!首领，这可怎么办啊!”
和李磊逃亡的一行人中有一个比较瘦的人发现李磊竟然昏了过去怕李磊再也醒不过来就连忙把李磊叫醒，可李磊竟然怎么也叫不醒，这可把他们急坏了，于是他们纷纷下马查看李磊的情况。
还好李磊并没有他们所想的那么脆弱，只不过是太累了加上心力憔悴才导致的。
李磊勉强站了起来看了看他们几人那狼狈的模样鼻子又是一酸，长叹了一口气，又环顾一周，不看不知道一看吓一跳，周围竟然都是悬崖峭壁，怪不得孙志才没有着急追他们，原来是他早就知道这里的情况。
“首领还好你没有事，怎么办啊是死路”刚才那个瘦子又问道，此时他十分着急害怕孙志才他们追过来。
“让兄弟们受苦了”李磊满脸惭愧道。
突然李磊定睛一看远处竟然有一个破旧的房屋，仔细一看是一个寺庙，于是一行人便决定前往寺庙，但由于路实在是崎岖只好步行前往。
“你叫什么名字啊”李磊对那正扶着他走路的瘦子问道。
“回禀首领，在下叫张强，当年俺四处流浪，是您收留了俺”张强笑了笑答道。
那寺庙看着近，实际上路程也是挺远，但一路上却是欢声笑语，完全没有把死亡和危机当回事，因为他们十分清楚在这无路可走的情况下，愁眉苦脸并不能改变什么，还不如好好享受人生最后的时光。
过了一会李磊一行人就走到了寺庙的门口，只不过令李磊意外的是这寺庙甚是古老看这个寺庙的建筑风格也是非常的古怪，更古怪的是这个寺庙看起来经历了无数岁月的洗礼竟然完好无损。
正常来说寺庙是非常神圣而且是非常让人感到安全的地方，但是这个寺庙竟然让人感觉非常奇怪，甚至还有一种非常浓郁邪气在这里蔓延，散发出十分危险又可怕的气息。
但对于李磊他们来说，这已经无所谓了，因为他们早已经知道自己的下场了，与其被那孙志才折磨致死还不如让这寺庙的危险给他们一个痛快呢！
李磊和他们互看几眼，满脸释然“如果有来世咱们一定还做兄弟!”说完便一起推开大门走了进去。
content_en:
When Liu Tinghan and others saw Li Lei's appearance, they all dismounted and protected Li Lei.
"Why are you so stupid!" Liu Tinghan then hugged Li Lei in his arms.
However, Sun Zhicai and other men in black who were chasing them stopped in front of them and did not take action.
"What a deep brotherhood, Li Lei. Look at you, you really did it yourself," Sun Zhicai said with a proud look on his face.
Faced with Sun Zhicai's words, Liu Tinghan and others were furious.
Liu Tinghan looked at Li Lei, then at the brothers behind him. He suppressed his anger and asked in a very humble tone, "Can you let Li Lei go? As long as you let him go, we can do whatever we want, even if we let us die."
"Hahaha! It's ridiculous. What's the use of you ants? Now that I regret it, not only will you die, but even Li Lei will have no chance of living!"
Sun Zhicai had just finished speaking, but the army of men in black behind him was getting ready to attack. It seemed that as soon as Sun Zhicai gave an order, the men in black would swarm forward and tear Li Lei and the others to pieces.
After hearing such words, Liu Tinghan did not discuss too much with Sun Zhicai, because he knew that with Sun Zhicai's character, he would definitely not survive even if he agreed to Li Lei.
So Liu Tinghan looked around, looked at each other with his brothers, then stood up and handed Li Lei to a brother next to Liu Tinghan. Then he turned around and faced Sun Zhicai, his fists clenching loudly.
"A few people will take Li Lei away. Anyone who is not afraid of death will be killed by me!"
Liu Tinghan and others were seen resolutely rushing towards the overwhelming army of men in black, leaving only a few people and Li Lei there.
The brother holding Li Lei in his hand did not hesitate too much, hugged Li Lei and a few others, mounted his horse and ran away into the distance.
Li Lei looked at the scene of Liu Tinghan and others going away and fighting with the group of men in black. Li Lei was close to collapse. Li Lei was not greedy for life and feared death. He just watched Liu Tinghan, who was like his own brother, trapped in a bitter fight. Faced with such a situation, he was powerless and could only watch him die. At this moment, Li Lei's heart was even more turbulent, with mixed feelings, and the tears of disappointment in his eyes were flowing uncontrollably.
I don't know whether it was due to excessive sadness or too much blood loss that Li Lei fainted.
"Wake up! Chief, what are we going to do?"
A relatively thin man among the group of people who fled with Li Lei found that Li Lei had passed out, so he hurriedly woke Li Lei out of fear that Li Lei would never wake up again, but Li Lei couldn't wake up, which made them anxious, so they all dismounted to check on Li Lei's condition.
Fortunately, Li Lei was not as fragile as they thought. It was just caused by being too tired and mentally exhausted.
Li Lei reluctantly stood up and looked at the miserable appearance of them. His nose felt sore again. He sighed and looked around again. He was shocked when he saw that there were cliffs all around. No wonder Sun Zhicai didn't chase them in a hurry. It turned out that he had known the situation here for a long time.
"Fortunately, Chief, you're fine. What should I do? It's a dead end." The thin man asked again. At this time, he was very anxious and afraid that Sun Zhicai and the others would chase him.
"I've made my brothers suffer," Li Lei said with shame on his face.
Suddenly, Li Lei took a closer look and saw a dilapidated house in the distance. Upon closer inspection, it was a temple, so the group decided to go to the temple, but because the road was really rough, they had to walk there.
"What's your name?" Li Lei asked the thin man who was helping him walk.
"Reporting to the leader, my name is Zhang Qiang. When I was wandering around, you took me in," Zhang Qiang replied with a smile.
The temple looked close, but in fact the journey was quite far, but there were cheers and laughter along the way, and they didn't take death and crisis seriously at all, because they knew very well that in this desperate situation, frowning and frowning could not change anything, so they might as well enjoy the last time of their lives.
After a while, Li Lei and his party walked to the door of the temple. What surprised Li Lei was that the temple was very old and the architectural style of the temple was also very weird. What was even weirder was that the temple seemed to have been intact after countless years of baptism.
Normally, temples are very sacred and a very safe place, but this temple actually feels very strange. There is even a very strong evil spirit spreading here, exuding a very dangerous and terrifying atmosphere.
But for Li Lei and the others, it didn't matter anymore, because they already knew their fate. Rather than being tortured to death by Sun Zhicai, it was better to let the danger of this temple give them a good time!
Li Lei looked at each other for a few moments, with relief on his face, "If there is an afterlife, we will definitely still be brothers!" After saying that, they opened the door and walked in together.
